description.value: Artisans' Studio is a local artist co-operative and gift shop located in downtown Nanaimo, describing itself as having 'a global reach.' Housed at 70 Bastion Street, it offers original artwork and gifts from local artists in a gallery setting. A touring cyclist exploring Nanaimo's Old City Quarter could stop in to browse local art and pick up a unique souvenir.
